sources.entry: Mac TV - Open-source Apple TV-style home screen for streaming apps, with a phone remote and a local movie player. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Arunprakaash/mac-tv) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Mac TV
summary.one_liner: Mac TV is an open-source app that turns a Mac connected to a TV into a streaming home screen, with a phone acting as the remote.
use_cases: Watch streaming apps like Netflix and YouTube on a TV connected to a Mac
Control a Mac-based TV setup from a phone
Play Steam games on a TV through Big Picture
Use a game controller with a Mac connected to a TV
Play local movie files on a TV from a Mac
summary.what_it_does: Mac TV provides an Apple TV-style home screen for streaming apps, including official Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video players, and lets any app or website appear as its own tile. The phone works as the remote: you scan a QR code to connect. It can skip intros and move to the next episode automatically, and it keeps working with the lid closed. It also offers Steam games and Big Picture through Steam, PlayStation and Xbox controller support, a sleep timer, and an Apple aerials screensaver. The listing describes it as open source with a local movie player, and it states that there is no account and no tracking.
notable: Phone as remote via QR code scan
Official Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video players plus any app or website
Steam Big Picture and PlayStation/Xbox controller support
No account, no tracking, nothing kept
caveats: Requires a Mac connected to a TV; it is built for that setup
Steam features work through Steam, so Steam must be installed
